reason.head.message: HEAD request from a link scanner
reason.head.note: why an open or a click counts as a machine's, shown in the live monitor's feed

reason.noAgent.message: No user agent, likely a scanner
reason.noAgent.note: user agent: what a browser says it is

reason.apple.note: Apple Mail Privacy Protection is Apple's feature, never translated

reason.fastOpen: Opened within 2 s of arriving, likely a scanner
reason.fastClick: Clicked within 10 s of arriving, likely a link scanner
reason.burst: Every link clicked within seconds, likely a link scanner

reason.honeypot.message: Followed the email's hidden link, a link scanner
reason.honeypot.note: a click on the hidden link of an email, which no person can see

reason.privacyProxy.note: an open fetched by a privacy proxy; name: the network as the instance admin named it

reason.securityScanner.message: Security scanner ({kind, select, headless {a headless browser} script {a script} bot {a bot} preview {a link preview} other {{name}}})
reason.securityScanner.note: name: the scanner's product (Barracuda, Microsoft Defender), never translated

reason.linkScanner: Link scanner ({kind, select, headless {a headless browser} script {a script} bot {a bot} preview {a link preview} other {{name}}})

client.unknown.note: the mail client a person opened or clicked in

client.anyOn.note: os: iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, Linux

client.on.note: app: a mail client or browser (Chrome, Apple Mail); os: its system (macOS)

page.gone.message: This link is no longer valid. If you copied it, check that the whole address came along.
page.gone.note: a plain page for someone who opens a broken tracked link from an email

problem.networkInvalid.message: Enter an address or a network, such as 203.0.113.0/24 or 2001:db8::/48.
problem.networkInvalid.note: a problem when an instance admin adds a scanner or privacy-proxy network

problem.networkTooWide: A network this wide would take ordinary readers for machines. Add a /{v4} or narrower network for IPv4, a /{v6} or narrower for IPv6.

problem.agentShort.message: Enter at least 3 characters of the user agent, such as AcmeGate-LinkCheck.
problem.agentShort.note: a problem when an instance admin adds a machine's user agent to the bot filter

problem.agentWord: A person's device is one word of its user agent, letters and digits only, such as KioskBot.

problem.agentPeople.message: “{pattern}” is in the user agents of browsers and mail clients people read email with, so it would take them for machines. Enter a word only the machine's user agent has.
problem.agentPeople.note: pattern: what the admin typed, never translated

problem.agentName: Say who or what it is, such as “our mail gateway”.
problem.agentNotRemovable: “{pattern}” isn't a user agent an admin added. Built-in user agents come with ReputeCast releases.
problem.networkNotRemovable: {cidr} isn't a network an admin added. Built-in networks come with ReputeCast releases.
